title: Another endless parking lot dream
content: This time I was in my grandma’s old car and she was angry with me for not wanting to go to college and I was frustrated bc I was like, I’m in my late 30s and I DID go to college and then I got out of the car in a parking lot and she disappeared the car started rolling away but the lot was, like, an endless sea of cars so I couldn’t find the original car to stop it from rolling out into the street
